title: Harbor and Typewriter
author: Silas Ishikawa
blurb: Astrid Reyes, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
